text: Bitcoin is treading water with a modest 0.9% gain while Ethereum lags at +0.5%, suggesting measured consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. Fear dominance (30) and rising Bitcoin dominance (56.8%) indicate investors are rotating toward safe havens, though the $53B volume remains relatively subdued for a risk-off environment.
